text:
anya: Quick question — when users download a trace from the viewer, should the default filename include the correlation id? pros: QA and SRE searchability. cons: potential PII in filenames for some customers.

marco: I'm leaning anonymized by default. Offer a clear opt-in toggle in the export modal: 'Include correlation ID'. Default off for orgs with strict compliance.

ash: runtime-wise we can attach corr-id easily. Suggest backend returns a sanitized final filename preview so UI shows exactly what will be written. Also add a size estimate endpoint for large traces.

jess: platform: we'll add audit logging when corr-id is included and a feature flag orgs can flip. For permalinks, we can emit a signed short token that maps to the trace but doesn't expose ids.

anya: UI plan: small export chevron in trace header -> modal with: filename input, example pill (shows pattern), toggles: [Include correlation ID] [Anonymize IPs] [Format: JSON/CSV]. Primary button text: 'Download'.

marco: copy: tooltip for corr toggle = 'Helps link logs across systems; may contain identifiers.' Keep it concise.

a11y-bot: checklist: focus trap in modal, aria-describedby for toggle tooltip, announce size estimate updates with role=status, ensure copy-icon keyboard accessible. File an a11y ticket if any missing.

anya: perfect. Next: I'll mock in Figma and post a quick review. @ash will you confirm the preview endpoint? @jess confirm audit log + signed token?

ash: yes — `/export/preview?trace_id=...&include_corr=true` returns `final_name` and `est_bytes` within 24h sprint.

jess: confirmed. will add audit log and a platform flag `include_corr_default=false`.

anya: thanks all — will ping with Figma link. :sparkles:
